query: For a 63-year-old male like my patient, what's the maximum hospital length of stay (days) among males aged 58–68?
final_sql:
WITH PatientAdmissions AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    p.gender,
    p.anchor_age,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS p
  INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` AS a
    ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 58 AND 68
    AND a.dischtime IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  MAX(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a.dischtime, a.admittime, DAY)) AS max_length_of_stay_days
FROM
  PatientAdmissions AS a;
